headline: 4,837 hijacked GitHub accounts ran a CI secret stealer in 1,806+ repos; Apache HTTP/2 RCE CVE-2026-119618; Barracuda ESG KEV due 11-13

bullets.text: New: The Hacker News reports an attacker used 4,837 hijacked GitHub accounts to run a CI secret stealer in more than 1,806 repositories. Any CI secrets exposed to workflows in affected repos should be treated as at risk.
Critical Apache HTTP Server flaw CVE-2026-119618 is an HTTP/2 issue that could let unauthenticated attackers execute code remotely, per Wiz and The Hacker News. The brief gives no fixed release.

ScreenConnect attacks using rogue clients have reached at least 288 endpoints across 48 organizations, with MSPs breached. N-central remains offline after a researcher published dozens of zero-days (6 outlets).

KEV due 11-13: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (exploited, 4 outlets) and Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. Today, 11-12, is the deadline for OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex.

Still exploited: critical Xen Orchestra flaws (3 outlets); Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 and Openwave CVE-2026-111793 (4 outlets, KEV due 11-24). Outlook CVE-2026-124194 and Chromium CVE-2026-125350 are also due 11-24.

Breaches and state activity: Maersk confirmed a breach as WhiteArmor demands $5 million; Vanderbilt on lockdown after ransomware (6 outlets); France blames Iran for sabotage at about 700 retail sites (5 outlets). SITCON 3 holds; week runs 1.07x the 90-day average.

actions: Review GitHub audit logs and recent workflow runs for unfamiliar accounts; rotate secrets exposed to CI and limit workflows from outside contributors.
Find internet-facing Apache HTTP Server hosts with HTTP/2 enabled; restrict exposure and patch as soon as a fixed release or distro package ships.
Inventory ScreenConnect instances, remove unknown or rogue clients, patch, and review session logs; keep N-central access restricted.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 by 11-13 and hunt for compromise; patch Ivanti Connect Secure.
Confirm OpenSSH, GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex patches are done today, their KEV deadline.
Keep Xen Orchestra off the internet; patch Outlook, Chrome, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave by 11-24.
